contracts.description: Reads one allowed workspace or Runtime-output file. Supports bounded text ranges, images, notebooks, and visual PDF pages. Use an absolute path and read an existing file completely before overwriting it.

errorCodes.when: The canonical target is outside an allowed read root or crosses a forbidden symlink.
The canonical target is absent or not a regular readable file.
The requested projection is unsupported.
The requested or decoded content exceeds a declared bound.

contracts.name: Read
contracts.resultSemantics: Return bounded text with line metadata or one validated image/PDF attachment projection; notebook content is normalized text.

contracts.description: Creates a new file or atomically replaces a previously read file inside an allowed workspace. Existing files require a current complete Read receipt.

errorCodes.when: An existing target has no current complete Read receipt.
The target changed after its qualifying Read.
The target is outside an allowed write root or changes identity.
The atomic commit precondition no longer matches.

contracts.name: Write
contracts.resultSemantics: Atomically create or replace one managed file and return its committed identity and eligible checkpoint receipt.

contracts.description: Performs an exact string replacement in a text file. By default old_string must occur exactly once; replace_all replaces every non-overlapping occurrence. Notebook files are unsupported.

errorCodes.when: The target has no qualifying Read receipt.
old_string has no exact occurrence.
old_string is ambiguous while replace_all is false.
The target or publication precondition changed.

contracts.name: Edit
contracts.resultSemantics: Commit exact non-fuzzy replacement and return count, new identity, retained-change notice, and eligible checkpoint receipt.

contracts.description: Finds files by glob pattern under an allowed directory. Results include ignored files, are ordered by modification time, and are capped at 100 paths.

errorCodes.when: The search root is outside an allowed workspace.
The glob pattern is invalid or over limit.
The bounded search failed after validation.

contracts.name: Glob
contracts.resultSemantics: Return at most 100 canonical paths ordered by modification time with explicit truncation.

contracts.description: Searches file content with the artifact-pinned ripgrep executable. Supports content, file-name, and count modes without invoking a shell.

errorCodes.when: The search root is outside an allowed read root.
The expression or option combination is invalid.
The pinned ripgrep executable is unavailable.
The bounded search process fails.

contracts.name: Grep
contracts.resultSemantics: Return bounded content, file-name, or count records with stable pagination and truncation metadata.

contracts.description: Runs a Bash command in the workspace using the sealed execution environment. Commands may run in the background and return a read-only output path. The Runtime does not provide an OS sandbox.

errorCodes.when: The sealed Bash prerequisite is unavailable.
Hard policy or permission denies process execution.
A non-promotable bounded execution timed out.
The sealed environment cannot start the process.

contracts.name: Bash
contracts.resultSemantics: Foreground returns bounded streams and process terminal; background returns one retained WorkRegistry identity and output path.

contracts.description: List directory contents. Returns entries sorted alphabetically, with '/' suffix for directories. Includes dotfiles. Output is truncated to 500 entries or 50KB (whichever is hit first).

errorCodes.when: The target directory is outside the allowed workspace.
The target is absent or not a readable directory.
The bounded provider enumeration fails.

limit.description: Maximum number of entries to return (default: 500)
Maximum number of entries to return (default: 500)

contracts.name: ls
contracts.resultSemantics: Return the retained lowercase ls textual result with alphabetical entries, directory suffixes, dotfiles, and exact truncation bounds.

contracts.description: Fetches an HTTP or HTTPS URL under the Runtime network policy, converts supported content, and answers the supplied prompt with a tool-free utility model call.

errorCodes.when: The operation network policy denies the request or redirect.
Scheme, credentials, DNS, IP, redirect, or rebinding checks reject the destination.
The response cannot be converted safely.
The isolated tool-free utility call fails.

contracts.name: WebFetch
contracts.resultSemantics: Return a bounded utility-model answer with final URL, citations, converted-content provenance, and separately metered usage.

contracts.description: Searches the web through a supported Provider server-side adapter and returns cited results. This tool is absent when the operation-frozen Provider has no compatible adapter.

errorCodes.when: The frozen Provider has no approved server-side search adapter.
Domain constraints conflict or exceed bounds.
The Provider returns a failure, rate limit, or invalid result.

contracts.name: WebSearch
contracts.resultSemantics: Return Provider-native cited results and separately attributable usage; HTML scraping fallback is forbidden.

contracts.description: Asks one to four structured questions and returns the single registered response to this tool call. Use only when the interaction owner is available.

errorCodes.when: No interactive or deterministic headless provider can answer.
The interaction owner rejects or expires the request.
A late or duplicate response loses exactly-one settlement.

contracts.name: AskUserQuestion
contracts.resultSemantics: Return the one registered answer set, including explicit free text when Other is selected.

contracts.description: Enters persisted plan mode and allocates or resumes its managed plan artifact. Plan mode immediately restricts execution to plan-safe actions.

errorCodes.when: The caller is not the root Agent or hard policy disallows entry.
The durable plan state cannot be created or resumed atomically.

contracts.name: EnterPlanMode
contracts.resultSemantics: Persist plan mode and return the managed plan artifact identity and revision before the restricted catalog becomes visible.

contracts.description: Submits the current managed plan revision for approval. Approval exits plan mode; rejection or cancellation keeps plan mode active.

errorCodes.when: No approval provider is available.
The submitted revision is no longer current.
Approval is rejected, cancelled, or expired while plan mode remains active.

contracts.name: ExitPlanMode
contracts.resultSemantics: Approval returns the submitted plan and normal mode; rejection or cancellation returns feedback while plan mode remains active.

contracts.description: Loads one model-invocable SKILL.md from the operation-visible approved DSH Skill catalog, strips frontmatter, expands deterministic arguments, and returns its bounded instructions inline.

errorCodes.when: The named Skill is absent from the frozen catalog.
The Skill disables model invocation.
The resource cannot be validated or expanded within bounds.

contracts.name: Skill
contracts.resultSemantics: Return bounded frontmatter-stripped instructions from the exact operation-visible declarative Skill catalog.

contracts.description: Starts a supervised local child Agent with a fresh DSH context and the current bounded workspace/component snapshot. Omit subagent_type to use the built-in general descriptor. General children have coordination tools but no direct filesystem authority, so include the material to review in the prompt. Background returns a retained work handle; foreground waits for the child terminal.

errorCodes.when: No compatible child descriptor or model alias is visible.
A child attempts to spawn another child.
A background child requires unavailable interaction.
The supervised child reaches a failed terminal.

contracts.name: Agent
contracts.resultSemantics: Foreground returns the child terminal and usage; background returns one supervised WorkRegistry handle and output path.

contracts.description: Stops an owned background Bash process or child Agent by task ID and waits for terminal state and resource finalization.

errorCodes.when: The task is unknown or belongs to another Runtime Session.
The WorkRegistry cannot establish terminal cleanup.

contracts.name: TaskStop
contracts.resultSemantics: Wait for the addressed work item to reach its existing or newly stopped terminal and finalize owned resources.

contracts.description: Delivers an ordered plain-text message to one resolvable parent, child, or sibling Agent in this Runtime Session. Cross-Session and broadcast delivery are unsupported.

errorCodes.when: The local recipient cannot be resolved.
The target is cross-Session, broadcast, team, or cloud-owned.
The ordered mailbox or resume path cannot accept the message.

contracts.name: SendMessage
contracts.resultSemantics: Return an ordered delivery receipt after resolving one in-scope collaborator.

contracts.description: Creates a task in the current Runtime Session-local TaskGraph. It does not create a product task or scheduled automation.

errorCodes.when: The graph or metadata bound is reached.
The append cannot commit against the current revision.

contracts.name: TaskCreate
contracts.resultSemantics: Append one task to the Session-local TaskGraph and return its immutable ID and committed revision.

contracts.description: Gets one task and its current dependency, owner, flat scalar metadata, and revision snapshot from the Session-local TaskGraph.

errorCodes.when: The task is absent or not visible.
The durable graph projection cannot be read safely.

contracts.name: TaskGet
contracts.resultSemantics: Return one task and graph revision from the durable Session-local projection.

contracts.description: Lists a bounded, stable snapshot of non-deleted tasks in the current Runtime collaboration domain.

errorCodes.when: The durable graph projection cannot be read safely.
The projection exceeds its declared output bound.

contracts.name: TaskList
contracts.resultSemantics: Return a bounded stable task list and graph revision from the Session-local projection.

contracts.description: Atomically updates one Session-local task, including status, ownership, dependencies, text, and bounded flat scalar metadata. Set owner to root in the same update (or earlier) before status can become in_progress. Dependencies must remain acyclic.

errorCodes.when: The target task does not exist.
A dependency is absent, cross-Session, self-referential, or cyclic.
The update attempts an invalid terminal transition.
The graph revision precondition fails.

contracts.name: TaskUpdate
contracts.resultSemantics: Atomically update one task and dependency graph and return the committed task, graph revision, and changed fields.

source.engineAdaptation: Pi registration and lifecycle glue replaced by public DSH service seams
